mapper.select: SELECT pi_id FROM bike_pi_export WHERE status='PENDING' OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)) ORDER BY pi_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_pi_export SET status='PROCESSING',claim_token=#{token},lease_until=DATE_ADD(NOW(3),INTERVAL 10 MINUTE),attempts=attempts+1,revision=revision+1,error_code=NULL WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND (status='PENDING' OR (status='PROCESSING' AND lease_until < NOW(3)))

UPDATE bike_pi_export SET status='READY',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='PROCESSING' AND pdf_key IS NOT NULL AND xlsx_key IS NOT NULL
UPDATE bike_pi_export SET status='FAILED',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=#{code},revision=revision+1 WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND claim_token=#{token} AND status='PROCESSING'
UPDATE bike_pi_export SET status='PENDING',claim_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,error_code=NULL,revision=revision+1 WHERE pi_id=#{piId} AND revision=#{revision} AND status='FAILED'
